title: Duality for Delsarte's extremal problem on locally compact Abelian groups
summary: The Delsarte extremal problem for positive definite functions, originally introduced by Delsarte in coding theory to bound the size of error-correcting codes, has since found applications in diverse areas such as sphere packing, Fuglede's spectral set conjecture, and $1$-avoiding sets. Recent developments have established the existence of extremizers in fairly general settings and identified precise linear programming dual formulations, together with strong duality results, in several important cases including finite groups and $\mathbb{R}^d$.
